gaps_reported_by_model: No production electricity or heat for cutting and assembling the panelling; only the profile, the two surface treatments and the transport.
No production waste or its disposal.

The aluminium profile line appears twice (17.5 kg + 13.8 kg = 31.3 kg per m2 of visible frame area), once for the anodised and once for the powder-coated variant, so the dataset appears to be a weighted mix of the two surface treatments rather than one product.
